'''The Orbit''' was a nightclub in the [[peacekeeping zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]. Neon signs written in [[Aurebesh]] were used to attract potential customers, although some of them were upside-down. According to the signage, the club offered [[swamp]] baths.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
